title: Horn of plenty: why Scotland's national animal has never existed

words.note: 来自古希腊神话，是装满水果鲜花的羊角，象征富足，也叫 cornucopia。标题双关：独角兽那只角，加上苏格兰到处都是独角兽。
words.ctx: Horn of plenty: why Scotland's national animal has never existed

ex.en: The painting shows a goddess holding a [[horn of plenty]].
ex.zh: 这幅画画的是一位手持丰饶之角的女神。

ex.en: The harvest table was a real [[horn of plenty]].
ex.zh: 丰收的餐桌简直是一只丰饶之角。

words.def: a curved horn full of fruit and flowers, used as a symbol of having plenty of everything

cloze.before: Horn of
cloze.after: : why Scotland's national animal has never existed

words.note: 代表一个国家、组织的图案或事物：the national emblem（国徽、国家象征）。
words.ctx: Most countries choose an eagle, a lion or a bear as their emblem; Scotland settled on a beast from legend.

ex.en: The maple leaf is Canada's national [[emblem]].

ex.en: The team wears its [[emblem]] on every shirt.
ex.zh: 球队每件球衣上都印着队徽。

words.def: a design or object that represents a country, group or idea

cf.diff: symbol 最常用，可以是任何代表某种意思的东西（如 + 号）；emblem 多指国家、团体正式使用的标志图案。

ex.en: The dove is a [[symbol]] of peace.
ex.zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。

words.note: 常用进行时 be teeming with：The river is teeming with fish.（河里到处是鱼。）

ex.zh: 表格按要求签好交回了。

words.def: in the correct or expected way; at the expected time

cf.diff: 形近词：duly /ˈdjuːli/ 是“如期地、照例地”；dully 是“沉闷地、暗淡地”。

ex.en: The light glowed [[dully]].
ex.zh: 灯光暗淡地亮着。

cloze.before: England's lion and Scotland's unicorn were
cloze.after: placed on either side of the shield, where they remain to this day.
cloze.szh: 于是，英格兰的狮子和苏格兰的独角兽被分别放在盾牌两侧，一直保留到今天。

words.zh: 边界以北（英国人指苏格兰）
words.note: 在英国，the border 常指英格兰和苏格兰之间的边界，north of the border 就是“在苏格兰”。
words.ctx: In the version used north of the border, the unicorn takes pride of place.

ex.en: Prices are a little lower [[north of the border]].
ex.zh: 苏格兰那边物价低一点。

ex.en: The law is different [[north of the border]].
ex.zh: 在苏格兰，法律不一样。

words.def: (in Britain) in Scotland, seen from England

cloze.before: In the version used north of the
cloze.after: , the unicorn takes pride of place.
cloze.szh: 在苏格兰使用的版本里，独角兽占据了最显眼的位置。

words.note: take / have pride of place：被放在最重要、最显眼的位置：The trophy takes pride of place on the shelf.
words.ctx: In the version used north of the border, the unicorn takes pride of place.

ex.en: Her wedding photo takes [[pride of place]] on the wall.
ex.zh: 她的婚纱照挂在墙上最显眼的地方。

ex.en: The new car had [[pride of place]] at the show.
ex.zh: 这辆新车在展会上占据了最显要的位置。

words.def: the most important or noticeable position

cloze.before: In the version used north of the border, the unicorn takes
cloze.after: of place.
cloze.hint: 最显要的位置（___ of place）
cloze.szh: 在苏格兰使用的版本里，独角兽占据了最显眼的位置。

words.note: be divided over / on sth：对某事意见不一：Experts are divided over the cause.
words.ctx: Historians are divided over why.

ex.en: The family was [[divided over]] where to go on holiday.
ex.zh: 家里人对去哪度假意见不一。

ex.en: Scientists remain [[divided over]] the question.
ex.zh: 科学家们在这个问题上仍有分歧。

words.def: having different opinions about something

cloze.before: Historians are
cloze.after: over why.
cloze.szh: 历史学家对其中的原因看法不一。

words.note: 作名词：great power or strength：military might（军事力量）、with all my might（使出全身力气）。情态动词 might 大家都熟。
words.ctx: Some argue that the chains signalled the might of a king who could tame even the wildest creature; others see a wry nod to how dangerous the animal was thought to be when left unchecked.

ex.en: She pushed the door with all her [[might]].
ex.zh: 她使出全身力气推门。

ex.en: The parade was a show of military [[might]].
ex.zh: 那次阅兵是军事力量的展示。

words.def: great power or strength

cloze.before: Some argue that the chains signalled the
cloze.after: of a king who could tame even the wildest creature; others see a wry nod to how dangerous the animal was thought to be when left unchecked.
cloze.szh: 有人认为，锁链显示了国王的威力，连最狂野的动物都能驯服；也有人把它看作一种带着幽默的暗示：人们认为这种动物一旦失去约束会有多危险。

words.note: 表示觉得有点好笑，同时带点无奈或讽刺：a wry smile（苦笑）、wry humour（冷幽默）。
words.ctx: Some argue that the chains signalled the might of a king who could tame even the wildest creature; others see a wry nod to how dangerous the animal was thought to be when left unchecked.

ex.en: He gave a [[wry]] smile when he lost again.
ex.zh: 他又输了，苦笑了一下。

ex.en: Her book is full of [[wry]] observations.
ex.zh: 她的书里满是带冷幽默的观察。

words.def: showing that you find something amusing in a slightly sad or ironic way

cf.diff: dry humour 是一本正经地说笑话；wry 更强调带点自嘲、无奈或讽刺。

ex.en: He has a very [[dry]] sense of humour.
ex.zh: 他的幽默感很冷。

words.note: a nod to sth：对……的暗示、致敬：The film's title is a nod to an old song.
words.ctx: Some argue that the chains signalled the might of a king who could tame even the wildest creature; others see a wry nod to how dangerous the animal was thought to be when left unchecked.

ex.en: The design is a [[nod to]] the 1960s.
ex.zh: 这个设计是在向 60 年代致敬。

ex.en: His speech included a [[nod]] to his old teacher.
ex.zh: 他的讲话里提到了他的老师，算是致意。

words.def: a small sign that shows you know about something or respect it

words.zh: 不受约束的、未加控制的
words.note: go / be left unchecked：任其发展：If left unchecked, the disease will spread.
words.ctx: Some argue that the chains signalled the might of a king who could tame even the wildest creature; others see a wry nod to how dangerous the animal was thought to be when left unchecked.

ex.en: If left [[unchecked]], the weeds will take over.
ex.zh: 要是不管，杂草会长满。

ex.en: Prices rose [[unchecked]] for years.
ex.zh: 物价多年来不受控制地上涨。

words.def: not controlled or stopped

cloze.before: Some argue that the chains signalled the might of a king who could tame even the wildest creature; others see a wry nod to how dangerous the animal was thought to be when left
cloze.szh: 有人认为，锁链显示了国王的威力，连最狂野的动物都能驯服；也有人把它看作一种带着幽默的暗示：人们认为这种动物一旦失去约束会有多危险。

words.note: nursery 是“托儿所”，rhyme 是“押韵的诗”。如 Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star。
words.ctx: An old nursery rhyme, in which the lion and the unicorn brawl over the crown, hints at a rivalry that has never quite subsided.

ex.en: My grandmother taught me this [[nursery rhyme]].
ex.zh: 这首儿歌是我奶奶教我的。

ex.en: Many [[nursery rhymes]] have strange origins.
ex.zh: 很多童谣的来历都很奇怪。

words.def: a short traditional poem or song for young children

cloze.before: An old nursery
cloze.after: , in which the lion and the unicorn brawl over the crown, hints at a rivalry that has never quite subsided.
cloze.szh: 有一首古老的童谣，讲狮子和独角兽为争夺王冠大打出手，暗示着一场从未真正平息的较量。

words.note: 在公共场合吵吵嚷嚷地打群架：a pub brawl（酒吧斗殴）。brawl over sth：为……打架。
words.ctx: An old nursery rhyme, in which the lion and the unicorn brawl over the crown, hints at a rivalry that has never quite subsided.

ex.en: Fans [[brawled]] outside the stadium.
ex.zh: 球迷在体育场外打成一团。

ex.en: Two men were arrested after a [[brawl]] in a bar.
ex.zh: 两名男子在酒吧斗殴后被捕。

words.def: to fight in a noisy and rough way, usually in a public place

cf.diff: scuffle 是短暂的小推搡、小扭打；brawl 是吵闹、混乱的群殴。

ex.en: There was a brief [[scuffle]] at the door.
ex.zh: 门口发生了短暂的推搡。

cloze.after: over the crown, hints at a rivalry that has never quite subsided.

words.note: 风暴、疼痛、怒气、洪水等慢慢减弱：The pain subsided.（疼痛减轻了。）
words.ctx: An old nursery rhyme, in which the lion and the unicorn brawl over the crown, hints at a rivalry that has never quite subsided.

ex.en: We waited for the storm to [[subside]].
ex.zh: 我们等着暴风雨平息。

ex.en: Her anger slowly [[subsided]].
ex.zh: 她的怒气慢慢消了。

words.def: to become less strong or loud; to return to normal

cf.diff: 形近词：subside 是动词“平息”；subsidy 是名词“补贴”（已学）。

ex.en: Farmers receive a government [[subsidy]].
ex.zh: 农民领取政府补贴。

cloze.before: An old nursery rhyme, in which the lion and the unicorn brawl over the crown, hints at a rivalry that has never quite
cloze.szh: 有一首古老的童谣，讲狮子和独角兽为争夺王冠大打出手，暗示着一场从未真正平息的较量。

words.note: 把别人的东西、想法或符号拿来为自己服务：Brands often co-opt youth culture.（品牌常把青年文化拿来用。）
words.ctx: Today the unicorn has been co-opted by everyone from toymakers to tech investors, who use the word for start-ups valued at more than a billion dollars.

ex.en: The song was [[co-opted]] for a car advert.
ex.zh: 这首歌被拿去做了汽车广告。

ex.en: Politicians try to [[co-opt]] popular slogans.
ex.zh: 政客们总想把流行口号据为己用。

words.def: to use an idea or symbol for your own purposes

cloze.before: Today the unicorn has been
cloze.after: by everyone from toymakers to tech investors, who use the word for start-ups valued at more than a billion dollars.
cloze.hint: 拿来为己所用（过去分词）
cloze.szh: 如今，从玩具商到科技投资人，人人都把独角兽拿来为己所用；投资人用这个词指估值超过十亿美元的初创公司。

words.note: 某样东西突然流行、很快又过时：the latest craze（最新的热潮）。
words.ctx: Scots regard this craze with a certain amusement.

ex.en: Every child wanted one during the yo-yo [[craze]].
ex.zh: 溜溜球热的时候，每个孩子都想要一个。

ex.en: The [[craze]] for bubble tea shows no sign of ending.
ex.zh: 奶茶热丝毫没有退潮的迹象。

words.def: something that suddenly becomes very popular for a short time

cf.diff: trend 是一般的发展趋势，可长可短；craze 强调突然、狂热又短暂。

ex.en: There is a growing [[trend]] towards working from home.
ex.zh: 在家办公的趋势越来越明显。

cloze.before: Scots regard this
cloze.after: with a certain amusement.
cloze.szh: 苏格兰人看待这股热潮，多少带着点好笑。

words.note: 很想吵架或打架的样子：a belligerent tone（挑衅的语气）。来自拉丁语“打仗”。
words.ctx: Their unicorn, they point out, is not a sparkly pony but a belligerent beast with a horn like a lance.

ex.en: The drunk man became [[belligerent]].
ex.zh: 那个醉汉变得很好斗。

ex.en: She replied in a [[belligerent]] tone.
ex.zh: 她用挑衅的语气回答。

words.def: unfriendly and wanting to argue or fight

cf.diff: aggressive 很常用，还可以是褒义（积极进取：aggressive marketing）；belligerent 更正式，只表示敌意、想打架。

ex.en: Some dogs are [[aggressive]] towards strangers.
ex.zh: 有些狗对陌生人很凶。

cloze.before: Their unicorn, they point out, is not a sparkly pony but a
cloze.after: beast with a horn like a lance.
cloze.szh: 他们指出，他们的独角兽可不是亮晶晶的小马，而是一头好斗的猛兽，头上的角像一杆长矛。

words.note: 中世纪骑士骑马冲刺时用的长矛。
words.ctx: Their unicorn, they point out, is not a sparkly pony but a belligerent beast with a horn like a lance.

ex.en: The knight lowered his [[lance]] and charged.
ex.zh: 骑士放低长矛，冲了过去。

ex.en: The museum has a row of old [[lances]].
ex.zh: 博物馆里有一排古老的长矛。

words.def: a long spear used by soldiers on horses in the past

cloze.before: Their unicorn, they point out, is not a sparkly pony but a belligerent beast with a horn like a
cloze.szh: 他们指出，他们的独角兽可不是亮晶晶的小马，而是一头好斗的猛兽，头上的角像一杆长矛。

words.note: 作动词：大力支持、为……奔走：champion women's rights（捍卫女性权利）。名词“冠军”大家都熟。
words.ctx: A nation that has spent centuries championing an animal nobody has ever seen can hardly be accused of lacking imagination.

ex.en: She has [[championed]] cycling in the city for years.
ex.zh: 她多年来一直在城里推广骑自行车。

ex.en: The paper [[champions]] local businesses.
ex.zh: 这家报纸力挺本地商家。

words.def: to publicly support a person, idea or cause

cloze.before: A nation that has spent centuries
cloze.after: an animal nobody has ever seen can hardly be accused of lacking imagination.
cloze.szh: 一个几百年来一直推崇一种谁也没见过的动物的国家，总不能说它缺乏想象力吧。

words.note: extinct：灭绝的。go / become extinct：灭绝。名词 extinction。
words.ctx: And unlike eagles and bears, unicorns will never go extinct.

ex.en: The dodo [[went extinct]] long ago.
ex.zh: 渡渡鸟很久以前就灭绝了。

ex.en: Many frogs could [[go extinct]] this century.
ex.zh: 许多青蛙可能在本世纪灭绝。

words.def: to stop existing as a species

cloze.before: And unlike eagles and bears, unicorns will never go
cloze.szh: 而且和老鹰、熊不一样，独角兽永远不会灭绝。

words.note: 祈使句后面接 and + 结果，表示条件：“只要……就……”。Look closely and you'll see ... = If you look closely, you'll see ...。如果接 or，就是“否则”：Hurry, or you'll be late.
words.ctx: Look closely, however, and the unicorn is almost always bound in chains.

ex.en: Work hard [[and]] you will pass.
ex.zh: 只要努力，你就能通过。

ex.en: Turn left at the church [[and]] you'll see the station.
ex.zh: 在教堂那儿左转，就能看到车站。

words.conn: 祈使句, + and + 结果（= If you ..., ...）；祈使句, + or + 结果（= 否则）

pick.q: Press this button ___ the door will open.
pick.why: 按按钮的结果是门会开，表示“只要……就……”，用 and。

pick.q: Hurry up, ___ you'll miss the bus.
pick.why: “快点，否则赶不上车”，表示“否则”，用 or。

cloze.before: Look closely, however,
cloze.after: the unicorn is almost always bound in chains.
cloze.hint: 仔细看就会发现（Look closely, however, ___）
cloze.szh: 可是仔细看，你会发现那只独角兽几乎总是被锁链捆着。
